info.name: StackHR Backend API
info.description: Postman API collection for StackHR backend modular monolith.

item.name: Observability & Health
item.description: System telemetry, Prometheus metrics scrape endpoints, readiness/liveness health probes.

request.description: Scrapes Prometheus metrics text format including P50/P90/P95/P99 latency histograms, HTTP request counters, Idempotency engine events, Outbox DLQ depth, Circuit Breaker states, and Node.js process runtime stats.

response.name: Success (200 OK)
response.body:
# HELP stackhr_http_requests_total Total number of HTTP requests processed by StackHR backend
# TYPE stackhr_http_requests_total counter
stackhr_http_requests_total{method="GET",route="/v1/api/employees",status_code="200"} 142

# HELP stackhr_http_request_duration_seconds HTTP request latency in seconds across P50, P90, P95, and P99 percentiles
# TYPE stackhr_http_request_duration_seconds histogram
stackhr_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.05",method="GET",route="/v1/api/employees",status_code="200"} 130
stackhr_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf",method="GET",route="/v1/api/employees",status_code="200"} 142
stackhr_http_request_duration_seconds_sum{method="GET",route="/v1/api/employees",status_code="200"} 3.421
stackhr_http_request_duration_seconds_count{method="GET",route="/v1/api/employees",status_code="200"} 142

# HELP stackhr_outbox_dlq_depth Current number of dead-lettered events requiring operator attention
# TYPE stackhr_outbox_dlq_depth gauge
stackhr_outbox_dlq_depth 0

# HELP stackhr_circuit_breaker_state Current state of external client circuit breakers (0 = CLOSED, 1 = HALF_OPEN, 2 = OPEN)
# TYPE stackhr_circuit_breaker_state gauge
stackhr_circuit_breaker_state{breaker_name="PenCentral"} 0

request.description: Liveness and readiness health check probe reporting database latency, process memory stats (heap, RSS), circuit breaker health, and DLQ depth.

query.description: Maximum number of DLQ events to retrieve (default: 50, max: 100)

variable.description: UUID of the dead letter event to replay

request.description: Platform Admin endpoint to replay a dead letter event by reinstating it as a fresh PENDING event in the Transactional Outbox and removing it from the DLQ.
